jobDescription:
Are you passionate about helping organisations unlock the potential of Artificial Intelligence and shaping innovative solutions that deliver real business value?

As our Pre-sales AI Solutions Architect within the AI Practice, you'll combine technical leadership, client engagement and strategic thinking to help grow our AI capabilities across a wide range of UK sectors. You'll have the opportunity to shape and own innovative AI solutions, influence technology strategy, and help clients realise the benefits of emerging technologies.

This is a highly visible, client-facing role where you'll work closely with senior stakeholders, lead complex bid activities and support the growth of both our AI Practice and architecture capability. You'll also represent Sopra Steria at industry events and conferences, helping to build our market presence and showcase our expertise.

We can offer great career progression opportunities, ability to be based anywhere across the UK, benefits which you can flex to meet your needs, and training and development opportunities.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing AI architecture team while fostering strong relationships across Sopra Steria.
  • Support the definition and refinement of business requirements for AI opportunities and initiatives.
  • Design and own technical solutions across pre-sales, delivery and reusable architectural blueprints.
  • Develop compelling AI propositions and support go-to-market activities across multiple sectors.
  • Lead technical solution design activities and author high-quality bids, proposals and client presentations.
  • Build trusted client relationships and represent Sopra Steria at industry events, conferences and customer engagements.

What you’ll bring:

  • Proven pre-sales experience, including authoring bids, developing proposals and helping secure new business opportunities.
  • Experience designing and delivering AI solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence technologies, including Machine Learning, Generative AI, AI Agents, AWS AI and Azure AI.
  • Experience developing AI-enhanced digital assistant solutions such as Microsoft Copilot.
  • Practical experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and Machine Learning Operations (MLOps).
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

It would be great if you had:

  • Experience working across multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles and ethical AI frameworks.

If you're interested in this role but not sure if your skills and experience are exactly what we're looking for, please do apply, we'd love to hear from you!

Employment Type: Full-time Permanent.

Location: Can be based anywhere in the UK.

Security Clearance Level: Must be eligible for SC clearance.

Salary: Up to £101,000.

Benefits: £6,600 car allowance, 25 days annual leave with the option to buy additional days, private medical, life assurance, pension, and generous flexible benefits fund.

Although this role is advertised as full-time, we believe that flexibility at work can promote work/life balance, increase your motivation, reduce stress and improves performance and productivity. We support different ways of working and can offer a range of flexible working arrangements. So, if you're interested and need to work flexibly, we encourage you to apply and talk to us about what might be possible.

We combine the full power of Sopra Steria's Insight, Technology and Transformation capabilities to deliver positive, meaningful and long-lasting outcomes for our clients. We're the partner of choice for organisations who are looking to tackle the most complex problems with new solutions. We empower our clients by providing innovative solutions and commercial models that help them meet their business needs, drive operational efficiencies, and deliver impactful value creation.

Job title: Data Analyst

Locations: Manchester (hybrid working)

Role overview

As a Data Analyst at Markerstudy, you will contribute to the delivery of analytics solutions that support strategic decision-making across our insurance brands. Working within the Analytics & Enrichment team, you’ll help generate insights that improve insurer panel performance collaborating with teams across pricing and insurer relations.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong analytical foundation, a passion for data, and a desire to grow their technical and commercial skills in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

Markerstudy is a leading provider of private insurance in the UK, insuring around 5% of the private cars on the UK roads, 20% of commercial vehicles and over 30% of motorcycles in total premium levels of circa £1b. Most of Markerstudy’s business is written as the insurance pricing provider behind household names such as Tesco, Sainsbury’s, O2, Halifax, AA, Saga and Lloyds Bank to list a few.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality analysis: Produce accurate, timely insights that support day-to-day business decisions.
  • Answer business questions with data: Analyse datasets to explain performance, identify trends, and highlight opportunities or risks.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders: Work with partners to understand requirements, clarify questions, and respond to feedback.
  • Maintain reporting and dashboards: Build, refresh, and monitor reports tracking key metrics and KPIs.
  • Support analytical models and processes: Contribute to the development, testing, and ongoing monitoring of existing models such as marketing selection models.
  • Continuously develop analytical skills: Build technical and business knowledge, staying curious and open to new tools and techniques.

Key Skills and Experience:

  • Strong academic background in a numerical discipline (eg BSc Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science).
  • Proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python and/or R.
  • Understanding of statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g. regression, clustering).
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Desirable

  • Postgraduate qualification in relevant field (eg Computer Science, Data Science, Operational Research)
  • Experience with modern data platforms (eg Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric).
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and version control tools (e.g. Git).
  • Experience with deployment and maintenance of ML models in production environments.
  • SQL
  • MS Excel
  • Power BI
  • Python and/or R

Behaviours:

  • Collaborative and team player
  • Logical thinker with a professional and positive attitude
  • Passion to innovate and improve processes

Job Description

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and experienced Data Engineering team at AJ Bell, contributing significantly to the development of our state-of-the-art data platform using cutting-edge technology. As a Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, maintaining, and evolving our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the growing needs of our business. You'll engage in end-to-end development, collaborate closely with key stakeholders and internal customers, and empower the organisation by enabling informed, data-driven decision-making.

What does the job involve?

The key responsibilities of the role are as follows:

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to identify and refine data requirements, ensuring data is accessibility and alignment with business needs.
  • Developing Data Warehousing solutions.
  • Automating extract, load and transform (ELT) pipelines that follow modern CI/CD practices.
  • Data Integration Design – Ensure development is scalable, efficient and future-proof.
  • Data Modelling – Producing clear data models where necessary.
  • Maintaining and continuously enhancing the data platform.
  • Provisioning data from various sources.
  • Create automated tests to ensure quality and integrity of data.
  • Ensure data is compliant with AJ Bell’s Data Governance and Data Classification policies.
  • Maintain data dictionary.
  • Maintain business level data model.
  • Recommending and introducing new technology where needed.

Core:

  • Cloud data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Data transformation technology such as DBT
  • Visual Studio Code
  • Python
  • CI automation systems such as Jenkins
  • A git-based source control system such as BitBucket
  • Data Warehouse/Kimball methodology
  • Data replication technology such as Fivetran HVR.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams

Other:

  • Good knowledge of IT products and systems
  • Good analytical skills
  • Excellent communication skills verbal and written
  • Able to communicate with people at all levels confidently and effectively
  • Able to prioritise work effectively
  • Customer focussed
  • Flexible approach to work - team player
  • Adaptable to changing environment
  • Self-motivated
  • Embraces continuous learning
  • Previous experience working in an e-commerce and/or financial services business
  • Ability to use Docker and container orchestration tools
  • AWS cloud infrastructure including AWS CDK
  • MS SQL
  • No SQL database such as Mongo
  • AI Tools such as CoPilot, Snowflake Cortex

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer

  • 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
  • 6% Pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

AI Implementer – Graduate Opportunity

£27,000 per annum pro rata

Part Time

Are you a recent graduate with a genuine interest in Artificial Intelligence and technology?

Do you enjoy finding smarter and more efficient ways of doing things?

Would you like the opportunity to help a business introduce AI into its everyday operations?

We are looking for a bright and inquisitive AI Implementer to join a Manchester-based business on a part-time basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who understands the potential of AI and wants to gain practical experience implementing it within a real commercial environment.

The Role

This isn't a traditional IT or software development position. As AI Implementer, you will work with different areas of the business to understand existing processes and identify where AI and automation could save time, improve efficiency and enhance the way people work.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Reviewing existing business processes and identifying opportunities to use AI.
  • Researching and testing AI tools and applications.
  • Introducing practical AI solutions into everyday workflows.
  • Creating prompts, templates and repeatable AI processes.
  • Using AI to support administration, research, marketing and reporting.
  • Helping automate repetitive and time-consuming tasks.
  • Working with employees to understand where technology could make their jobs easier.
  • Training and supporting colleagues in the effective use of new AI tools.
  • Measuring the impact of new processes and recommending improvements.
  • Keeping up to date with developments in AI and emerging technology.
About You

We are particularly interested in a recent graduate who is naturally curious about AI and enjoys experimenting with new technology.

You will ideally have:

  • A degree in any relevant discipline.
  • A genuine interest in AI, automation and emerging technology.
  • Experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot or similar AI platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good Microsoft Excel and general IT skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • The confidence to explain technology to non-technical colleagues.
  • A practical, hands-on approach – someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions.

Programming experience is not essential. We are more interested in someone who understands how AI can be practically applied to improve a business.

What's on Offer?

£27,000 per annum pro rata, part-time hours and the opportunity to take ownership of an exciting AI implementation project within an established Preston business.

For the right graduate, this is an opportunity to build genuine commercial AI experience rather than simply studying the technology – identifying opportunities, implementing solutions and seeing the impact of their work.

Shape the Future with AI & Data


We are looking for talented AI / Data Engineers to join a growing technology consultancy delivering innovative data, analytics and AI solutions for enterprise clients. This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern cloud, data and AI technologies, helping organisations unlock value from their data and accelerate digital transformation.Whether your background is in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, or both, you'll have the opportunity to design and build scalable solutions that deliver real business impact.


As one of our AI / Data Engineers, you will:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and data platforms
  • Develop analytics and AI-enabled solutions that support business decision-making
  • Create and implement machine learning and generative AI solutions
  • Integrate data from multiple sources while ensuring data quality and reliability
  • Work closely with analysts, product teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimise systems for performance, scalability and efficiency
  • Contribute to testing, monitoring and quality assurance activities
  • Produce clear technical documentation and follow data governance and security best practices


If you possess a combination of some of the following skills, then LETS TALK!

  • Experience as an AI Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Developer or similar
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience building data pipelines and working with both structured and unstructured data
  • Knowledge of AI, machine learning or generative AI technologies
  • Exposure to frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain or similar
  • Experience working with cloud based data platforms and modern data architectures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience delivering solutions within Agile environments


In return, you will be rewarded with an enviable benefits package in addition to:-

  • Working on cutting-edge AI and data transformation projects
  • Collaborating with highly skilled engineers, analysts and consultants
  • Gaining exposure to enterprise-scale cloud and AI technologies
  • Hybrid working model with Manchester-based collaboration
  • Excellent opportunities for career progression and professional development


Successful applicants must be eligible to obtain UK Security Check (SC) Clearance.

We're bringing payroll, HR and workforce management together on a single, modern platform, and we've rebuilt our product and engineering model around it from the ground up: AI-first, fast, and unlike anything the business has done before.

This is a genuine inflection point. The foundations are being laid right now, and you'd be joining while there's still real shape to give — not walking into a mature product with years of legacy to wade through. It's fast-moving, it's new, and plenty of it is still being figured out. That's the appeal.

We're looking for a Product Owner who turns platform strategy into the specifications our delivery teams build against, day in, day out.

This position is on a hybrid working pattern, with 3 days per week in our Manchester office.

We work in small, autonomous, cross-functional teams — we call them Pods — that bring Engineering, QA, UX and Product together around measurable outcomes rather than feature output. It's a deliberately modern, AI-first way of working, and it moves quickly.

As Platform Product Owner you sit inside the Pod. The Platform Product Manager sets the strategy, the commercial case and the roadmap; you turn that into a clear, sequenced backlog of precise, buildable specifications, make the day-to-day trade-off calls that keep the Pod moving, and accept the work as it's delivered. You are the difference between a good brief and a good product.

Here's the part that makes platform work different: the platform is the foundation the rest of the business builds on, so your customers aren't only end users. The Payroll, HR and Workforce Management teams rely on what the platform provides to build their own products — they're your customers too. Serving all of them cleanly, at once, is the hardest and most rewarding part of the job.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write specifications with precision — Author specs and acceptance criteria clear and unambiguous enough for the team to build from directly, with nothing left to guess. This is the core of the role.
  • Own the Pod's backlog — Turn the Platform Product Manager's roadmap into a clear, sequenced backlog the Pod can build against.
  • Serve the domain teams as customers — Gather what Payroll, HR and WFM need from the platform and make sure it serves all of them cleanly — not just the loudest.
  • Make the day-to-day calls — Own in-Pod prioritisation and trade-offs so Engineering, QA and UX always know what matters most right now.
  • Accept the work — Review delivered work against spec and acceptance criteria, and sign it off before it ships.
  • Run the Pod's rhythm — Drive Pod ceremonies — planning, stand-ups, retros — keeping the team focused on outcomes, not just output.
  • Curate platform domain knowledge — Keep specs and platform context current as the platform evolves, working alongside the Architect and engineering.
  • Close the learning loop — Feed what the Pod learns during delivery back into the roadmap and sequencing.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst in a SaaS or software product environment — ideally translating strategy into detailed, buildable specifications.
  • Exceptional written precision — you can write specifications and acceptance criteria that leave no room for ambiguity.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn — you're energised by new tools and new ways of working, and comfortable when the path isn't fully mapped out yet. This is not a role for someone who needs everything defined before they move.
  • Comfortable working daily inside a fast-moving, cross-functional delivery team — you thrive on the pace and the collaboration.
  • A structured, evidence-based approach to backlog prioritisation and trade-offs.
  • Strong stakeholder skills — able to serve multiple internal product teams whose own work depends on your platform.
  • Existing right to work in the UK.

Highly desirable:

  • Experience with platform or shared-services product areas — identity, integration, shared data, workflow — rather than standalone feature products.
  • Experience with modern, AI-assisted development approaches — and structured specification beyond traditional user stories.
  • Knowledge of payroll, HR or wider HCM software.

Good to have:

  • Experience of working with Azure DevOps.
  • Experience working across multi-product or multi-team architecture.

This is a full time, permanent role on a hybrid basis, 3 days per week in Manchester. You'll work daily alongside your Pod (Engineering, QA, UX) and closely with the Payroll, HR and Workforce Management Product Managers and Owners, with some collaboration across our other pods. Occasional travel for workshops and team events will be required.
